purpose: Byte-preserving non-data recovery inventory; mathematical acceptance and complete rollback snapshot creation are separate tasks.
proposed_path_base: All destination_relative_path values are relative to a NEW snapshot or recovered-study root selected by the caller; do not overlay the active repository.
copy_contract: Perform only actions copy_file and extract_member to obtain the unique-byte payload.
Use binary reads/writes; preserve every source byte, including absence of a final newline. Do not rewrite links, names inside text, line endings, or encoding.
Verify source/archive SHA-256 and byte size immediately before copying; verify destination SHA-256 and size afterwards. Abort on drift.
For ZIP entries locate the exact member_index and member_path; verify archive hash and member hash. Stream only listed members; never extractall or recurse automatically.
Reject absolute paths, '..' components, backslashes/drive prefixes, symlinks, special files, encrypted entries, duplicate member names, and pre-existing destination paths or symlink parents.
Enforce 16 MiB per selected archive source member and no unlisted extraction. No directory, nested ZIP, raw array, coefficient table or cache entry is selected.
Existing-repository duplicate entries identify required source bytes already present in the main snapshot; check that the main non-data snapshot actually retains at least one listed path.
Reuse entries retain alias provenance. A complete path-layout restoration can materialize byte copies from the referenced selected file; unique storage alone is not a runnable reconstructed package.
Do not run recovered scripts, archived verifiers, document builders, or experiments during copying.
scope_limits: One name-filtered listing of /tmp and recursive inspection of the 21 listed relevant directories; no exhaustive recursive search of unrelated /tmp trees.
Repository and other-checkout traversal omitted .git, node_modules, __pycache__, .venv, venv and .cache; symlinks were not followed.
Only seven report-listed codex-b attachments were inspected; the 620,486,061-byte session corpus was neither opened nor reproduced.
Source-pattern scan, hashes, document openings/headings/endings and selected dependency/provenance inspection; not independent mathematical reading of every temporary note.

Excluded generated tables, raw arrays, executables, public-paper text/PDF downloads, rendered/layout caches, data-embedded visualizations, unrelated Lean probes, and operational metadata. Preserved three unique original .backups PDF document editions.

The /tmp stieltjes pre-cleanup tarball and other unrelated or binary temporary archives were not unpacked. Archive-member coverage is the 14 repository ZIPs plus their nine verified duplicate nested ZIPs.
Some sources refer to intentionally excluded data or to duplicate files stored elsewhere; this is a preservation inventory, not a self-contained executable reproduction.
Complete non-data rollback requires the main repository snapshot plus these selected bytes and alias/provenance manifests; no such snapshot was created here.
